reviewed_by: Astra independent editorial pass and lead integration
gaps: When an alien form of closeness leaves a permanent alteration in physical morphology, how does the community distinguish between an act of devotion and an act of predation?
When alien intimacy permanently reconfigures anatomy, what structural or energetic signature separates an act of devotion from predation?

accepted.item: Exuvia-grazing: For creatures whose past developmental instars shed hard carapaces containing calcified sensory memories, closeness means allowing an elder peer to gnaw the discarded husk, metabolizing errors and frights the original body was too frail to digest directly.
accepted.why: Memory-bearing shed carapaces are an explicit alien premise; another being metabolizing them is a coherent consequence. The mechanism is not ordinary feeding because the material carries lived sensory content.

accepted.item: Shared blind-arc: Near-radial beings see in every direction except an unclosable wedge behind their primary spine. Trust consists in standing spine-to-spine so each watches approaches hidden from the other, surrendering the possibility of facing one another.
accepted.why: An actual blind wedge contradicts 360-degree vision; a distinguished primary spine also qualifies radial symmetry. Mutual coverage of approaches is clearer than a claim to watch total vulnerability.

accepted.item: Latency-fold: Among hive-minds separated by light-hours of orbital distance, intimacy is the suspension of predictive data compression, streaming raw observational drift across interplanetary lag and accepting asynchronous, uncoordinated self-modification.
accepted.why: The proposed version removes the unsupported six-day arrival time. Uncompressed observational access plus interplanetary lag is a clear informational intimacy distinct from shared circulation or simultaneous sensation.

accepted.item: Silt-deposition: For beings who exist as transient river vortices, coupling is the mutual deceleration over gravel beds to drop suspended mineral grains together, leaving a joint sandbar that survives long after both currents dissipate into open surf.
accepted.why: Vortex selves jointly depositing a durable trace give an intelligible persistence contrast. Their deceleration and sandbar are consequences within the invented agency premise, not claims about sentient terrestrial currents.

accepted.item: Fallow-lending: Parasitic archival species whose accessible memories all burn with equal volcanic intensity achieve tenderness by temporarily transferring a partner's grief into vacant neural tracts, insulating the lender of the memories from their own dead until the season turns.
accepted.why: Clarifies whose grief moves and who is relieved. The original combination of remembering everything and being insulated from a relocated memory left the transfer's effect underspecified.

accepted.item: Cross-tensile bracketing: Crystalline entities unable to touch one another without catastrophic shear wedging link their frames through a shared intermediary stone; they sense each other only through the stone's shear vibrations, which both must damp to keep the joint from breaking.
accepted.why: A frequency is not itself something that is damped. Shared vibration and active load management restore the vivid original transaction without invoking mystical resonance or pretending this is established engineering.

accepted.item: Somatic misattribution: Organisms that reproduce by budding off identical limbs exchange appendages during winter dormancy. Intimacy is waking up to move a hand that was trained by someone else's childhood habits and slowly unlearning its reflexes.
accepted.why: Treat limb-local learned reflexes as part of the alien premise. Exchanging bodily habit and then unlearning it is a distinct perturbation of continuity, not merely borrowed memory storage.

accepted.item: Pore-confluence: Siphonophore-like alien colonies merge marginal circulatory manifolds temporarily, suspending self-recognition markers while digestive signals and chemical alarms circulate through both bodies without retaining their source identity.
accepted.why: Avoids attributing invented immune and circulatory machinery to actual siphonophores. Loss of signal provenance earns the boundary-of-self mechanism; the proposed version merely promised alarms would calm down.

accepted.item: Asymmetric flensing: Lithic beings whose surface script records civic identity carve relief grooves into each other's outer stratum; predation strips stone smooth to harvest mass, whereas intimacy selectively deepens existing distress-fractures to render historical trauma structurally legible.
accepted.why: Surface-script preservation versus mass-stripping is a precise distinction in the declared lithic culture. Admit as its described intimate practice, not proof that every carefully deepened fracture was benevolent.

accepted.item: Cavitation-welding: Chitinous pelagic swimmers whose living plates fuse after acoustic micro-fracture discharge their prey-stunning shocks into each other's joint-capsules, welding opposing plates into a shared brace and surrendering rapid escape in exchange for mutual mechanical leverage.
accepted.why: Acoustic damage alone did not explain fusion or how damage produced shared leverage. A declared living-plate response and shared brace complete the invented transaction without a claim about ordinary chitin.

accepted.item: Vascular counter-threading: Vascular flora-intelligences interlace root-tips into a permanent reciprocal sap circuit: unlike parasitic weeds that drain one host, each partner supplies the other during local shortages, with equal volumes returned over a full seasonal cycle.
accepted.why: Distinguishes instantaneous transfer from cycle-level balance. Equalization during drought and no extraction at all are not interchangeable hydraulic claims; reciprocal accounting is a legible alien bonding rule, not a survival guarantee.

accepted.item: Chime-scarring: Brittle vitreous organisms contrast predation's shattered outer convexities with lovers' inwardly anchored radulae, which leave radial star-fractures by cracking the shell from within. The scars attest to interior access, not by themselves to consent.
accepted.why: The valuable mechanism is fracture direction and intimate access. Mechanics cannot establish consent merely because access occurred. Keeping the ambiguity produces a stronger field than an allegedly objective affection detector.

accepted.item: Baric imprint-welding: Gaseous mantle-dwellers compress their perimeter vortices into a joint low-pressure eye; an attack strips the envelope to inflate the predator's volume, while devotion creates a permanent twin-core circulation that costs both entities their maximum altitude.
accepted.why: A stable twin-core body with a reduced altitude ceiling is an intelligible invented aerodynamic cost. The world may stipulate this relation; it must not be sold as a deduction from known vortex physics or as proof against coercion.

residue.item: Void-grafting: Void-dwelling entities made of pressure differentials press their negative margins together until their internal vacuums equalize, risking instantaneous collapse if either boundary membrane tears from the sudden rush of neighbor-starved volume.
residue.why: Void pressure mechanics lean too heavily on colloquial terms of negative volume that obscure the actual physical transaction.

residue.item: Chronos-knotting: For asynchronous beings who experience life in reverse entropy, closeness is the rare, single afternoon where their forward and backward trajectories briefly intersect at the same biological age, spent exchanging gifts neither can keep.
residue.why: Reverse-entropy romance is a familiar human genre device that contradicts the stated focus on rigorous ontological divergence.

residue.item: Epistemic paring: Polyphonic hive-clusters prune back their own perimeter nodes to invite an alien colony's sensory tendrils into the cleared margin, relying on morphological deficit rather than chemical verification to signal non-hostility.
residue.why: Overlaps strongly with fallow-lending and pore-confluence without adding a novel bodily constraint.
